title: Django Basics
intro: Django interview questions for freshers focus on the MTV architecture and the batteries-included features that make Django the most common framework name-dropped in entry-level Python JDs. This page covers the MTV pattern (Model-Template-View — how it maps to the MVC you learned in college, and why Django calls the controller a 'view'), the distinction between a Django project and a Django app (project = the whole site, app = a reusable component — this trips up almost every fresher), models and migrations (defining a model class, running makemigrations and migrate, why you need both commands), function-based views and URL patterns in urls.py, templates with the Django template language (context variables, if/for tags), the Django ORM at the basics level (Model.objects.all(), filter(), create(), get()), and the Django admin site (register a model, what you get for free, why it's a superpower for rapid development).
